## Problem

Describe the user-facing problem and link the issue.

## Change

Describe the behavior change and compatibility impact.

## Verification

- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] `cargo fmt --all --check`
- [ ] `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`
- [ ] `cargo test --workspace`
- [ ] Documentation and changelog updated
- [ ] No secret, telemetry, migration, or unexpected-network regression
